title: Yummy Crunchy Basque White Fish Choux
description: A rich, crunchy, cozy Basque‑French dish combining puffed choux pastry, tender white fish, and steamed spinach leaves for a nut‑free comfort meal.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C and line a sheet pan with parchment.
In a saucepan, combine water, butter, and salt; bring to a boil and then remove from heat.
Stir in flour until the mixture forms a smooth ball, then let it cool for five minutes.
Beat the egg white to soft peaks and fold into the dough; beat the yolk separately and fold it in next.
Pipe the dough into small rounds using a piping bag and place them on the parchment.
Arrange spinach leaves on the baking sheet, place fish fillets on top, then cover each fillet with a choux round, sealing the edges with a little water.
Brush the tops with olive oil and sprinkle oregano, piment d'espelette, and pepper over the choux.
Bake the assembly for 15 to 18 minutes until the choux puffs and turns golden brown.
Serve immediately with a squeeze of lemon and a side of steamed greens.
Check that the fish has reached an internal temperature of 63°C before serving.
